prompt:
You receive 2 images. Image 1 is a finished background painting of our point-and-click adventure game: the boarding hall of the Funitel valley station at Priehyba, Jasna, painted in summer 2035. Image 2 is the same painting with coloured boxes that only mark the interactive objects, the exits and the walkable floor, which must all stay exactly where they are. Edit image 1 into the SAME PLACE on 6 February 2035, a clear cold day in deep winter, seen by the SAME CAMERA: keep the exact viewpoint, lens, horizon, perspective and framing, and keep the position, size and outline of every building, wall, door, window, pole, rail, sign, piece of furniture, object and tree trunk. Change only what winter changes, as described below. Keep the painting technique, brushwork, palette handling and level of detail of image 1.

Inside the boarding hall everything stays exactly as in image 1 (the guide rail with the conveyor tyres, the red
bullwheel, the two black Funitel cabins, the handrail the box labelled 'Madlo' in image 2 (x 330-890, y 610-715 of the 1920x1080 frame (17-46 % from the left, 56-66 % from the top)), the gate with the green arrow lamp
the box labelled 'Nástup na Funitel' in image 2 (x 925-1155, y 585-720 of the 1920x1080 frame (48-60 % from the left, 54-67 % from the top)), the open cabin door the box labelled 'exit: Kabína Funitelu medzi Priehybou a Chopkom' in image 2 (x 960-1160, y 330-585 of the 1920x1080 frame (50-60 % from the left, 31-54 % from the top)), the pillar with the map the box labelled 'Mapa dvoch úsekov' in image 2 (x 1445-1655, y 330-565 of the 1920x1080 frame (75-86 % from the left, 31-52 % from the top)), the red steel
frame). Winter shows only at the open left side of the hall (the box labelled 'exit: Biela Púť pri dolnej stanici' in image 2 (x 0-160, y 380-725 of the 1920x1080 frame (0-8 % from the left, 35-67 % from the top))):
- Outside: a white, snow-covered mountain slope with snowy spruces and a groomed ski piste under a clear winter blue
  sky; the wooden railing outside carries a thick cap of snow with small icicles.
- A little snow has blown in: a thin, flat dusting of snow on the concrete platform near the opening, fading out
  towards the middle of the hall, and a few wet boot prints in it (flat, nothing standing on the floor).
NPC zone at x 1215-1365, y 490-790 of the 1920x1080 frame (63-71 % from the left, 45-73 % from the top): an animated character sprite will be drawn here later, so paint no person, figure or silhouette in it. The character's feet stand on the floor at y 790.
Walkable floor: the band at x 0-1920, y 724-1015 of the 1920x1080 frame (0-100 % from the left, 67-94 % from the top) stays one open, flat platform with nothing standing on it.

Fiction rules: no new lettering, no logos, no people, no animals.

Image 2 is a positioning aid only: do NOT draw any of its boxes, outlines, labels or captions. The result is image 1 edited, in the same 16:9 framing: no frames, no borders, no UI, no captions, no watermark, no text except the lettering already in image 1, and no people or animals unless stated above.

Lighting: a clear, cold, sunny winter day in the Low Tatras mountains: deep clean blue sky, low winter sun, crisp blue-violet shadows on the snow, sparkle on fresh snow, cold bright air. The brushwork, line quality and palette harmony stay exactly those of image 1 (style A).

Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.

blocking.status: natural re-blocking (product-owner decision 2026-10-05, docs/DECISIONS.md item 1), painter jasna2035
blocking.note: Boarding hall of the Funitel valley station at Priehyba as in the 2015 photo (and the CS09_2 cutscene frame): camera ~1.6 m high on the concrete boarding platform, looking across the hall at the docked black Funitel cabins hanging from the overhead guide rail with its rows of conveyor tyres; horizon y ~470; the cabins' floor and the platform edge with its handrail on y ~700-720 (~126 px per metre there). Perspective s(y) = (y - 470) / 545. Left: the open passage with daylight to the gondola arrival from Biela Put (exit), the red bullwheel; centre: a docked cabin with closed doors, the platform handrail, the boarding gate in front of a cabin with open doors (exit to the ride); right: Ivan by the gate, the two-section map board on a concrete pillar, the red steel frame of the station.

S67.ambient 2.reason: the steel handrail along the platform edge in front of the docked cabin (rail top y ~620, posts to y ~720)

S67.ambient 1.reason: the framed two-section map board on the concrete pillar: the gondola line and the Funitel line as two coloured lines with station dots

S67.IVAN.reason: Ivan the lift attendant stands on the platform right of the boarding gate
art brief: the attendant Ivan at the boarding point (standing figure)
